parentPalms.name: Ancestral Grand Mother Tree #1
parentPalms.yieldHistory: Consistently 160–180 high-weight seed nuts per year over 25 monitored years.
parentPalms.description: Our flagship mother palm planted in 1938. Exceptional trunk girth, dense canopy, and superior copra content.
parentPalms.nutCharacteristics: Large spherical nuts with 180g dry copra content and sweet water volume > 350ml.
parentPalms.whySelected: Unmatched germination rate (>94%) and strong wind tolerance during coastal storms.

parentPalms.name: East River Tall Palm #2
parentPalms.yieldHistory: 145–165 seed nuts/year average with early spadix emergence.
parentPalms.description: Located in fertile alluvial riverbank soil. Famous for fast germination and thick root collars.
parentPalms.nutCharacteristics: Medium-large green seed nuts with thick fibrous husk providing natural drought shield.
parentPalms.whySelected: High sapling survival rate in farm seedbed and rapid initial growth phase.

parentPalms.name: Coastal Shield Mother Tree #3
parentPalms.description: Seaward facing tall palm proven resistant to high saline breezes and soil salinity fluctuations.
parentPalms.nutCharacteristics: Thick husk with heavy endosperm and oil yield > 68%.
parentPalms.whySelected: Ideal parent palm for coastal region coconut plantation expansion.

parentPalms.name: Central Grove Prime Palm #4
parentPalms.description: Prime mother palm selected for high seednut weight and uniform seedling collar circumference.
parentPalms.nutCharacteristics: Heavy spherical seednuts with high water sugar content.
parentPalms.whySelected: Selected for quick 4-month germination and robust initial root anchorage.

parentPalms.name: Golden Husk Mother Tree #5
parentPalms.description: Golden-tinged husk variant with high husk fiber tensile strength and dense meat.
parentPalms.nutCharacteristics: Golden brown ripe nuts, 175g copra per nut.
parentPalms.whySelected: Proven drought tolerance and high pest immunity.

parentPalms.name: High Copra Mother Palm #6
parentPalms.description: Monitored for oil extraction yield; yields superior Grade-A copra.
parentPalms.nutCharacteristics: Compact round nut with dense solid kernel.
parentPalms.whySelected: Top candidate for commercial oil-yielding coconut orchards.

parentPalms.name: Heritage Giant Palm #7
parentPalms.description: One of our oldest registered mother trees with massive canopy spread.
parentPalms.nutCharacteristics: Extra-large seednuts yielding heavy sturdy saplings.

parentPalms.name: Fast Germinator Palm #8
parentPalms.description: Sprouts 2 weeks earlier than average in seedbeds.
parentPalms.nutCharacteristics: Thin husk, thick shell, large water cavity.
parentPalms.whySelected: Fastest farm sprout emergence rate on record.

parentPalms.name: Deep Root Mother Palm #9
parentPalms.description: Thrives in lower water tables with deep taproot architecture.
parentPalms.nutCharacteristics: Medium seednuts with resilient outer husk.

parentPalms.name: Sweet Water Mother Tree #10
parentPalms.yieldHistory: 150–170 nuts/year with high brix sweetness index.
parentPalms.description: Dual-purpose mother tree producing sweet tender water and rich mature copra.
parentPalms.nutCharacteristics: Large green-yellow nuts, 400ml sweet water capacity.
parentPalms.whySelected: Popular dual-purpose tender/mature coconut seedling lineage.

enquiries.name: Suresh Kumar
enquiries.message: Looking for 150 saplings for my 2-acre farm expansion next month. Please share transport details.

reviews.comment: Received extremely healthy saplings with thick collars and strong root systems. Packaging was carefully handled and survived transport without damage!
Outstanding Eathamozhy GI variety seedlings. Every single sapling germinated with deep green fronds.

faqs.question: Where are your saplings grown?
faqs.answer: All our coconut saplings are raised directly on our own ancestral farm in Eathamozhy, Kanyakumari district, Tamil Nadu.

faqs.question: How are saplings packaged for long-distance transport?
faqs.answer: Saplings are carefully rooted in nutrient-rich growing media and wrapped with protective moisture-retaining material to safeguard the fronds and collar stem during transit. Each consignment is securely packed and dispatched via trusted freight partners.
